compat.note: The target is 75,000 B and the build is under it. The limit is a ratchet just above what the build reached, so that it cannot grow back: lower it when the build shrinks. Raised from 72,000 for wasm-bindgen 0.2.130, which grew the build from 71,687 to 72,299 B (macOS) with no change of our code. Lowered to 72,050 when the profile hooks (`set_profile`, `timings`) left the shipped module: 71,997 B. Raised to 72,250 for 0.2.3: the crate version alone moves the build by about 130 B (the same code was 71,999 B as 0.2.1, 72,126 B as 0.2.2 and 71,974 B as 0.2.3), because the version feeds rustc's symbol hashes and so the order of the code, which brotli sees. A limit closer than that to the build fails releases by chance; 72,250 leaves room for it and stays under the target.
